// File-only public oracle for quoted trace uint32/fixed32 and enum fields.
package main

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	collector "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/collector/trace/v1"
	common "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/common/v1"
	resource "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/resource/v1"
	trace "go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp/trace/v1"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/encoding/protojson"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
)

func must(e error) {
	if e != nil {
		panic(e)
	}
}
func write(dir, name string, b []byte) { must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name), b, 0600)) }
func ids(value any) {
	switch v := value.(type) {
	case map[string]any:
		for k, item := range v {
			if k == "traceId" || k == "spanId" || k == "parentSpanId" {
				raw, e := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(item.(string))
				must(e)
				v[k] = hex.EncodeToString(raw)
			} else {
				ids(item)
			}
		}
	case []any:
		for _, item := range v {
			ids(item)
		}
	}
}
func main() {
	dir := os.Args[1]
	must(os.MkdirAll(dir, 0700))
	literals := []string{"0", "-0", "0.0", "-0.0", "1", "1.0", "1.000", "1e3", "1E+3", "10e-1", "1e-1", "1.5", "1.00000000000000000001", "2", "3", "5", "6", "2147483647", "2147483648", "4294967295", "4294967295.0", "4294967296", "4294967296.0", "-1", "-1.0", "9007199254740993.0", "0e1000000", "1e1000000", "1e-1000000", "1e-99999999999999999999999", "01", "+1", ".0", "1.", " 1", "1 ", "NaN", "Infinity", "", "SPAN_KIND_SERVER", "STATUS_CODE_OK"}
	cases := []map[string]any{}
	for _, owner := range []string{"resource", "scope", "span", "event", "link", "status"} {
		fields := []string{"droppedAttributesCount"}
		switch owner {
		case "span":
			fields = append(fields, "flags", "droppedEventsCount", "droppedLinksCount", "kind")
		case "link":
			fields = append(fields, "flags")
		case "status":
			fields = []string{"code"}
		}
		for _, field := range fields {
			for _, literal := range literals {
				var out proto.Message
				switch owner {
				case "resource":
					out = &resource.Resource{}
				case "scope":
					out = &common.InstrumentationScope{}
				case "span":
					out = &trace.Span{}
				case "event":
					out = &trace.Span_Event{}
				case "link":
					out = &trace.Span_Link{}
				case "status":
					out = &trace.Status{}
				}
				quoted, e := json.Marshal(literal)
				must(e)
				body := []byte(fmt.Sprintf(`{"%s":%s}`, field, quoted))
				err := protojson.Unmarshal(body, out)
				row := map[string]any{"owner": owner, "field": field, "literal": literal, "accepted": err == nil}
				if err == nil {
					descriptor := out.ProtoReflect().Descriptor().Fields().ByJSONName(field)
					value := out.ProtoReflect().Get(descriptor)
					if field == "kind" || field == "code" {
						row["expected"] = fmt.Sprint(value.Enum())
					} else {
						row["expected"] = fmt.Sprint(value.Uint())
					}
				}
				cases = append(cases, row)
			}
		}
	}
	encoded, e := json.Marshal(cases)
	must(e)
	write(dir, "cases.json", encoded)
	input := `{"resourceSpans":[{"resource":{"attributes":[{"key":"service.name","value":{"stringValue":"quoted-integers"}}],"droppedAttributesCount":"1.0"},"scopeSpans":[{"scope":{"name":"quoted","droppedAttributesCount":"2e0"},"spans":[{"traceId":"MDEyMzQ1Njc4OWFiY2RlZg==","spanId":"YWJjZGVmZ2g=","name":"quoted","startTimeUnixNano":"1700000000123456789","endTimeUnixNano":"1700000000123457789","flags":"4294967295.0","kind":2,"status":{"code":1},"droppedAttributesCount":"3e0","droppedEventsCount":"-0.0","droppedLinksCount":"10e-1","events":[{"name":"event","timeUnixNano":"1700000000123456789","droppedAttributesCount":"4.0"}],"links":[{"traceId":"MDEyMzQ1Njc4OWFiY2RlZg==","spanId":"YWJjZGVmZ2g=","flags":"257.0","droppedAttributesCount":"5e0"}]}]}]}]}`
	out := &collector.ExportTraceServiceRequest{}
	must(protojson.Unmarshal([]byte(input), out))
	write(dir, "traces-google-input.json", []byte(input))
	adapted := strings.ReplaceAll(input, `"traceId":"MDEyMzQ1Njc4OWFiY2RlZg=="`, `"traceId":"30313233343536373839616263646566"`)
	adapted = strings.ReplaceAll(adapted, `"spanId":"YWJjZGVmZ2g="`, `"spanId":"6162636465666768"`)
	write(dir, "traces-input.json", []byte(adapted))
	canonical, e := (protojson.MarshalOptions{UseEnumNumbers: true}).Marshal(out)
	must(e)
	write(dir, "traces-google.json", canonical)
	var tree any
	must(json.Unmarshal(canonical, &tree))
	ids(tree)
	canonical, e = json.Marshal(tree)
	must(e)
	write(dir, "traces-canonical.json", canonical)
	wire, e := proto.Marshal(out)
	must(e)
	write(dir, "traces.protobuf", wire)
}
